verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes product, so whether customer data trains AI models is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack has no statement about model training, no training opt-out, and no no-training commitment. Retention policies (including zero-day retention), transcript redaction, pause/resume recording, and admin deletion are adjacent privacy controls, not a guarantee against training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
